keyPoints.en: 1 July 1896: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang formed the FMS; capital Kuala Lumpur.
keyPoints.bm: 1 Julai 1896: Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan dan Pahang membentuk NNMB; pusat di Kuala Lumpur.

keyPoints.en: Resident-General (first: Frank Swettenham) held real power. Durbar (1897) and Federal Council (1909).
keyPoints.bm: Residen Jeneral (pertama: Frank Swettenham) memegang kuasa sebenar. Durbar (1897) dan Majlis Mesyuarat Persekutuan (1909).

keyPoints.en: Aims: uniform administration, shared development; result: rulers lost more power.
keyPoints.bm: Tujuan: pentadbiran seragam, pembangunan bersama; kesan: raja kehilangan lebih banyak kuasa.

keyPoints.en: Bangkok Treaty 1909: Siam gave Kedah, Perlis, Kelantan and Terengganu to Britain.
keyPoints.bm: Perjanjian Bangkok 1909: Siam menyerahkan Kedah, Perlis, Kelantan dan Terengganu kepada British.

keyPoints.en: Johor accepted a General Adviser in 1914.
UMS had British Advisers and more local control; they refused to join the FMS.
keyPoints.bm: NNMTB mempunyai Penasihat British dan lebih banyak kawalan tempatan; mereka enggan menyertai NNMB.
